principle: By Era Four, older practices, meanings, and mechanisms have simplified, compounded, and compressed into objects used in ordinary life. The game keeps short English compound names and precise effects. This lore book holds the fuller context; the objects do not require elaborate ceremonial names.
scope: These original Era Four designs cover all 33 care items: 22 potions and 11 medical supplies. Names and appearances have changed; effects, drawbacks, prices, boosts and saved inventory identities are preserved. Read the effects rather than guessing from shape or color. These are new gameplay interpretations, not quotations from earlier stories.

items.name: Threadshell
items.history: Mending has survived more clearly than the explanations once attached to it. Threadshell compresses the idea of holding a damaged pattern together into a small shell and one releasable knot; its everyday name describes what an Era Four caretaker can hold.
items.appearance: An impossible folded ivory ceramic spool, asymmetrical crescent jaws holding a suspended copper thread knot, tiny teal seams, ancient repaired domestic artifact.
items.activation: One-shot use: The copper binding unwinds from the crescent and gathers into a large released coil in its opening. The game performs the final fade.
items.effects: 50 silver. Clears Injury / Chronic. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
items.provenance: Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image 9a592da2-62da-49ce-b3f7-6f3ef8b59c77; animation e49bea2e-ff42-4d22-9c78-bcdcfcb7415a. Reduced motion holds a still.

items.name: Windseed
items.history: Windseed carries the old temptation to borrow effort from the next quiet interval. Its wound center gives the object an ordinary name, while its retained cost to an already strained pet belongs in the instructions, not in a reassuring color.
items.appearance: A squat dark indigo clockwork seed with three uneven brass fins, a pearly off-center eye and a coiled pale orange filament inside a slit, strange ancient handheld artifact.
items.activation: One-shot use: The shell opens fully and its orange spring shoots far upward into a long uncoiled spiral. The game performs the final fade.
items.effects: 22 silver. Exhaustion severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Energy +14; Happiness +4. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes. Drawback: existing Stress gains 1 severity and 5 minutes. This does not create an absent condition.

items.name: Doorfold

items.activation: One-shot use: The nested frames rise into open doorways and the orange core extends into a bright column. The game performs the final fade.
items.effects: 19 silver. Stress severity −2; reaching zero clears the condition. Happiness +5; Energy +5. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes.

items.activation: One-shot activation: The ribs hinge outward and the pearl releases two slow concentric ripples, then holds open. The game performs the final fade.
items.effects: 28 silver. Chronic severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Health +14; Happiness +3. items.name: Knotfork

items.name: Hearthpod

items.name: Daybud
items.history: Daybud joins the opening of a day with the opening of a small made flower. A new interval does not erase what a pet has lived through; it offers a modest practical aid within continuing care.

items.name: Threering
items.history: Threering carries three unlike pieces around one knot. Its compact form recalls shared support without claiming that any three-part object represents the entire Codex or the whole history of the world.

items.name: Lightweave
items.history: Lightweave compresses the old work of joining light and cloth into a patch a caretaker can unfold. By Era Four, the ordinary name and the practical gesture survive more readily than the explanations behind its stitched pattern.

items.history: Sweepfold preserves a familiar household gesture: opening a cloth and clearing a surface. The compressed Era Four object joins that gesture to care, while its written instructions retain the exact limits of its use.

items.history: Sealroll remembers the practical care of keeping a wrap closed until it is needed. Its small seal and wound strip carry that habit into Era Four without requiring a ceremonial title.
items.appearance: A sealed ribbon spindle. Break the seal and draw out its wrap.
items.effects: 16 silver. Injury / Infection severity −1; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +7; Cleanliness +4. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
items.activation: One-shot use: The seal pops off and the broad wrap unrolls from the spindle into a long open ribbon. The game performs the final fade.
items.provenance: Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image e3af35a5-5b8a-4b9d-bc2f-8496e9865674; animation b62a01e5-9231-4385-b0e6-53bcedbc9071. Reduced motion holds a still.

items.name: Clickthorn
items.history: Clickthorn compresses a release mechanism into a seedlike shell. Its smooth applicator and opening gesture belong to the made objects of everyday care; the name does not turn it into a plant or grant it protection beyond its recorded effects.
items.appearance: A smooth mechanical seed. Open its shell and press to discharge.
items.effects: 26 silver. Infection / Digestion severity −2; reaching zero clears the treated condition. Health +9; Energy +5. No recovery-timer change or Potion Boost.
items.activation: One-shot use: The violet shell splits wide to expose its applicator, which releases a bright spray. The game performs the final fade.
items.provenance: Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image 6f719cbc-bc44-4a9a-b555-7f1641e8a8d8; animation 1674b904-4454-450f-a67d-c4de1e6a0984. Reduced motion holds a still.
